text:
leah: Quick ask 1 Stratus Systems wants 150 racks moved up for an EU pilot in early May. Vendor says they can split the manifest but only if we commit a short-term priority window. Thoughts?

jae-novarack: We can split 70/80 and prioritize the 70 if Redwood marks them priority. Customs clearance historically adds 4-6 days in EU-2.

tom-supply: Current allocation: 320 racks in the marketplace pool (Q2). 150 would be drawn from that pool unless we use vendor buffer. If we mark priority, NovaRack can push one AWB ahead.

ravi: Product question: do we expose "priority_reserve" vs "soft_reserve" in partner API? We already have a `reserve_type` enum; adding a temporary flag is doable but needs 48h.

ben: Finance: moving 150 early will change revenue recognition and could trigger a promo credit reclaim. Need estimate of credit delta. Also confirm that shifting doesn't breach other partners' SLAs.

emily-csm: Two customers are scheduled for Q2 installs that reference that pool. Impact likely low but we should notify them ASAP. I'll draft a CSM note.

harry-finance: Preliminary calc: if we provide a 25% early-draw credit to the integrator, one-time cost ~ $38k. We can absorb with a PO amendment. Need product sign-off on routing and legal mitigation.

olga-legal: Short addendum OK to fast-track if it's purely timing. If we add a "priority" label, ensure we don't change liability or data terms. I'll prep language for signature.

ops-runbook: Quick runbook check: cross-dock slots for EU-1 week of May 4 are 60% booked. If AWB hits 05/02 we might need short-term weekend handling.

ravi: Implementation plan draft: 1) Add `priority_reserve` flag to partner API and portal (48h). 2) Create one-off routing policy to map AWB/slot to pilot. 3) Set max priority cap per partner (default 100 racks).

leah: Operational ask to NovaRack (draft):
```
Hi Jae,

Can you confirm split manifest 70/80 and mark AWB for 70 as priority for Stratus pilot? Need estimated customs docs ETA and earliest ship date. We'll confirm billing and routing by EOD.

Thanks,
Leah
```

jae-novarack: Confirmed. AWB ZN770 -> 70 racks, ETA 2026-05-02 (docs uploaded). AWB ZN771 -> 80 racks, ETA 2026-05-11 (docs pending).

ben: If AWB ZN770 lands and customs clears late, what's fallback? Dedicated reserved pool? Host overspill?

ravi: Fallbacks: 1) Route active jobs to Dedicated capacity (if customer has entitlement). 2) Use hot-swap from vendor buffer (chargeback applies). 3) If both unavailable, degrade to hosted with throttled throughput. Need to document SLA implications.

harry-finance: Approve credit up to $40k contingent on product gating the priority flag and legal sign-off. I'll send PO amendment template.

olga-legal: Draft addendum attached (will post in doc link). Key: limit the priority window to 14 days and include customs delay clause.

emily-csm: I'll message impacted customers and add a short FAQ. Also looping in Stratus contact to confirm pilot dates.

ops-runbook: Impact scan done: three customers with non-critical bookings; CSMs notified. Cross-dock team acknowledged potential weekend ops but can flex for one-off.

leah: Owners: Leah (vendor coordination + submit priority), Ravi (API & routing), Ben (finance + downstream impact), Olga (legal addendum), Emily (CSM comms). I'll send the vendor email now and update thread with AWB confirmations. :rocket:

jae-novarack: Sent shipping confirmation for ZN770 with docs. Tracking: https://tracking.novarack/ZN770.

leah: Thanks. Proceeding to submit a `priority_reserve` for 70 racks and a `soft_reserve` for 80 in EU-1. Posting console request now.

ravi: Console note: added toggle `partner_priority=true` on the reserve call. Beta pushed to staging.

harry-finance: PO amendment sent to procurement. Finance will reconcile the credit once billing is updated.

ops-runbook: Monitoring customs. If hold > 5d, trigger fallback plan: switch 50 racks to Dedicated buffer.

leah: Closing the loop: priority reserve submitted, vendor AWB ZN770 confirmed, legal addendum queued for signature, finance PO underway. Will post final status when ZN770 clears customs. :white_check_mark:
